summary: Fortune's review of the American Express Cash Magnet® Card, a no-annual-fee card with a flat 1.5% cash back rate on all purchases. It covers the 0% intro APR, the $200 new-cardmember bonus, redemption through statement credits, and a few modest perks. The card suits people who want simplicity, but it charges foreign transaction fees and lacks travel benefits, so frequent travelers should look at the Blue Cash Everyday or Discover it alternatives.
one_line: Fortune reviews the Amex Cash Magnet Card, a no-annual-fee card with flat 1.5% cash back, a $200 bonus and limited perks, suited to simplicity seekers.
key_facts: The American Express Cash Magnet® Card has a $0 annual fee and earns an unlimited 1.5% cash back on every purchase.
The intro APR is 0% for the first 15 months from account opening on purchases and on balance transfers requested within 60 days; afterward the APR is 19.24%–29.99% variable.
The balance transfer fee is either $5 or 3% of each transfer, whichever is greater; the minimum transfer is $100 and the maximum may not be more than $7,500.
The cash advance APR is 29.99% with a fee of either $10 or 5%, whichever is greater; the penalty APR is 29.99% variable.
The foreign transaction fee is 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars; late and returned payment fees are up to $40.
New cardmembers can earn a $200 statement credit by spending $2,000 in the first 6 months, and the credit can take eight to 12 weeks to arrive after reaching the spending requirement.

Balance transfers, cash advances, traveler's checks, prepaid cards and person-to-person transfers like Venmo earn no rewards, and no rewards accrue in a billing period if the minimum payment is not made by the due date.
Rewards are redeemed as statement credits at $1 per reward dollar with no minimum; credits apply within three days but cannot be used toward the minimum amount due.
Perks include American Express Experiences, secondary car rental loss and damage insurance, the Global Assist Hotline for trips 100 miles or more from home, and Plan It for purchases of $100 or more.
The Blue Cash Everyday® Card earns 3% on up to $6,000 per year each in groceries, U.S. online retail and gas stations, and 1% on other purchases.
The Discover it® Cash Back Card earns 5% on up to $1,500 in combined quarterly category purchases (then 1%) and matches all cash back earned in the first year.
American Express does not disclose a minimum credit score; Equifax defines good credit as 670 or higher, and users have reported limits from $1,000 to over $10,000.
The Cash Magnet is a standard plastic card, unlike the metal American Express Platinum Card.
